input.rationale: The Agreement contains no non-compete, exclusivity or field-of-use restriction binding us. Section 2(a) does the opposite of a restrictive covenant: it expressly confirms we are not obliged to use the License and are free to acquire, develop or license competing/similar software and services, subject only to not infringing TrueLink's IP (p0022/p0024) — an ordinary IP and confidentiality carve-out, not a business restriction. The licence grant itself is non-exclusive and the field-of-use language in Section 2(a) simply describes the permitted scope of TrueLink's Interface rather than limiting what businesses we may operate. The only "Non-Competition Agreement" reference (p0054) operates as a limitation on TrueLink's rights to use Credit Data, i.e. a restriction on the vendor, which is unobjectionable to us; we note that agreement is not attached or defined here, but that is a cross-reference housekeeping point rather than a restriction on our business. This meets the preferred position, so no redline is proposed.
